description: Capture part of a scene as a reusable glyph definition.
phrases: turn this part of the figure into a reusable glyph
promote a subtree into the library
save this shape so I can place it again
returns: the glyph definition to --out; what it captured, on stderr

examples.output: [lineart.polymerase] v1 captured from art: 3 element(s), 0 anchor(s). A captured glyph records geometry, not a construction, so it takes no parameters.

notes: GENERATED from `lineart_trace.scene.cli.verb_promote` by `python3 -m lineart_trace.records`. Edit that docstring, not this file: a record written by hand is a second copy of a description that already exists beside the code, and the two drift silently.
